{"metadata":{"description":"Dead-code detection for AI-generated codebases: graphlint builds a dependency graph, finds code unreachable from any entry point to enable codebase cleanup and functional‑effectiveness understanding.","id":"gh:1285824983","install_available":false,"language":"Python","name":"graphlint","slug":"AngelosZou/graphlint","topics":["dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Dead-code detection for AI-generated codebases: graphlint builds a dependency graph, finds code unre"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"achable from any entry point to enable codebase cleanup and functional‑effectiveness understanding."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# graphlint"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**Dead code detection for AI-generated codebases.**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"AI agents generate code rapidly, leaving behind dead and redundant code that pollutes the LLM's cont"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ext window and dilutes attention. Graphlint analyzes your codebase's dependency graph to identify en"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"try points and **detect dead code** — components unreachable from any entry point — so agents can se"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"lf-clean and keep the codebase lean."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Supported Languages"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| Language | Status | Parser | Features |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| **Python** (`.py`) | Built-in | `ast` (stdlib) | Decorators, type annotations, dynamic imports, fr"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"amework-aware entry detection |
| **Rust** (`.rs`) | Built-in (opt-in deps) | `tree-sitter` | Attrib"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ute macros, traits, `pub` visibility, `macro_rules!` |
| **C#** (`.cs`) | Built-in (opt-in deps) | `"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"tree-sitter` | Partial classes, properties/indexers/events, attributes, `.csproj` awareness, test fr"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"amework entries |
| **C / C++** (`.c` `.h` `.cpp` `.cc` `.cxx` `.hpp` `.hh` `.hxx`) | Built-in (opt-"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"in deps) | `tree-sitter` | struct/union/enum members, typedefs, macros, `#include` tracking, per-TU "},{"id":"p8s7","text":"`static` linkage, C library entry mode, C++ classes/namespaces/templates, cross-TU member-call resol"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"ution |
| **TypeScript / JavaScript** (`.ts` `.tsx` `.js` `.jsx` `.mts` `.cts` `.mjs` `.cjs`) | Buil"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"t-in (opt-in deps) | `tree-sitter` | JSX/React components, Next.js pages, NestJS decorators, Jest/Vi"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"test tests, import/export analysis |
| **GDScript / Godot** (`.gd` `.tscn` `.tres` `project.godot`) "},{"id":"p8s11","text":"| Built-in (opt-in deps) | `tree-sitter` + built-in resource parser | Scene/resource attachment, `pr"},{"id":"p8s12","text":"eload`/`load`/`class_name`, main scene and autoload entries, editor-wired `[connection]` callbacks, "},{"id":"p8s13","text":"`res://` path validation, dynamic-dispatch keep-alive |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Install optional language support:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"> C/C++ are analysed by a **single unified C/C++ analyzer** that owns `.c .h .cpp
> .cc .cxx .hpp .h"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"h .hxx`. It uses `tree-sitter-c` for C files, `tree-sitter-cpp`
> for C++ files, and routes a `.h` b"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"y the language of the TU(s) that include it
> — exactly as a C/C++ compiler does. One extra, `graphl"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"int[c]`, installs both
> grammars."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"> Godot is likewise analysed by a **single unified Godot analyzer** that owns
> `.gd` + `.tscn` + `."},{"id":"p12s2","text":"tres` + `project.godot`: scripts, scenes, resources and the
> project manifest must share one graph "},{"id":"p12s3","text":"for `detect_entries()` to see the main
> scene, the autoloads, the script each scene attaches and th"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"e callbacks the
> editor wires in one pass. Scripts use `tree-sitter-gdscript`; the INI-like
> resou"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"rce formats use a built-in parser."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- **Dead code detection** — finds components unreachable from any entry point via graph traversal
- "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"**Multi-language support** — Python, Rust, C#, C/C++ (unified), TypeScript/JavaScript, and GDScript/"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"Godot backends via a language adapter abstraction; Python uses stdlib `ast`, the others use `tree-si"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"tter` (Godot's `.tscn`/`.tres`/`project.godot` use a built-in resource parser)
- **Language-specific"},{"id":"p14s5","text":" awareness** — Python decorators, Rust attribute macros (`#[tokio::main]`, `#[test]`), C# attributes"},{"id":"p14s6","text":" (`[Fact]`, `[HttpGet]`), C translation-unit scope (`static` internal linkage, per-TU header `static"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"`s) and library entry mode, C++ classes/namespaces/templates, `enum class` members, and cross-TU mem"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"ber-call resolution, TS/JS JSX elements and ES module imports/exports, GDScript `class_name`/`signal"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"`/`@export`/`@onready`/`@tool`/`@rpc`, scene and `ExtResource` attachment, trait implementations, `p"},{"id":"p14s10","text":"ub`/`public` visibility, partial classes, and more
- **AST/CST parsing** — extracts functions, metho"},{"id":"p14s11","text":"ds, structs, enums, traits, impls, macros, classes, properties, indexers, events, variables, and fie"},{"id":"p14s12","text":"lds; aware of type annotations, destructured variables, and generics
- **Dependency graph** — builds"},{"id":"p14s13","text":" directed edges: `read`, `write`, `call`, `inherit`, `decorate`
- **Entry point detection** — built-"},{"id":"p14s14","text":"in rules covering Python frameworks (FastAPI, Flask, Django, Click, Typer, Celery, pytest), Rust con"},{"id":"p14s15","text":"ventions (main, async runtimes, WASM, proc macros, FFI, tests, pub API), .NET conventions (console, "},{"id":"p14s16","text":"xUnit, NUnit, MSTest, Web API, Minimal API, Generic Host, WinForms, WPF), C/C++ conventions (`main`/"},{"id":"p14s17","text":"`WinMain`/`wWinMain`/`DllMain`/`_tmain` for C and a free `main` for C++, `class_definition:` pattern"},{"id":"p14s18","text":"s, `test_file` by convention, and C library mode via external-linkage symbols), TS/JS conventions (m"},{"id":"p14s19","text":"ain, module index, CLI/server listen, Next.js pages, NestJS decorators, React JSX, Jest/Vitest tests"},{"id":"p14s20","text":"), and Godot conventions (the `project.godot` manifest, `class_name` public classes, `@tool` editor "},{"id":"p14s21","text":"scripts, `@rpc` remote methods, GUT/gdUnit4 tests, literal string dispatch and `.tscn`-wired callbac"},{"id":"p14s22","text":"ks) plus custom rules
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Limitations"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- **Static analysis only** — graphlint performs static analysis and cannot detect runtime linkage su"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ch as `getattr`, `importlib`, or dynamic dispatch patterns, which may result in false positives. Thi"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"s primarily affects Python; Rust's static dispatch model produces fewer false positives. **Mitigatio"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"n:** add custom entry rules matching your codebase's conventions. For example, graphlint's own codeb"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"ase uses `function_def:_detect_*` and `function_def:visit_*` patterns to prevent functions discovere"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"d via `getattr` from being flagged as dead.
- **Python dynamic imports** — due to Python's dynamic i"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"mport mechanisms (`importlib`, `getattr`, metaclasses, etc.), the default entry templates may produc"},{"id":"p16s8","text":"e false positives in codebases that rely heavily on runtime dispatch. Users should tune the `entry_r"},{"id":"p16s9","text":"ules` configuration to match their project's conventions.
- **Rust macro expansion** — tree-sitter p"},{"id":"p16s10","text":"arses unexpanded source; procedural macros and `macro_rules!` bodies appear as opaque token trees. S"},{"id":"p16s11","text":"ome macro-generated call paths may be missed. `#[derive]` attributes are partially recognized via im"},{"id":"p16s12","text":"plicit `inherit` edges.
- **C# partial classes & reflection** — tree-sitter parses each `.cs` file i"},{"id":"p16s13","text":"ndependently; partial class fragments are merged into a single logical node via `part_of` edges, but"},{"id":"p16s14","text":" members called only through reflection (`Activator.CreateInstance`, DI container registration) may "},{"id":"p16s15","text":"be missed, similar to Python's dynamic import limitations.
[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
